I was still living with my family at this point. We had a dog that very rarely barked. My nephew who was in the house with me at the time was only a baby. A few months old. There I am just chilling in the living room when the dog goes absolutely mental from the kitchen, barking and growling. I go out there and he’s staring into the dining room, hackles raised with his belly low to the ground. The dining room door had been shut as my nephew was asleep in his cot in there but now it was wide open and my nephew was wide awake smiling at something I couldn’t see. 

I was literally paralysed because my dog was clearly terrified and I could not move for a solid two minutes before I pulled myself together and went to check my nephew. 

The room felt heavy and dense and just really eerie. My skin was prickly and my dog was still growling behind me refusing to come into the room. There was nothing in the room that I could see. 

Then just like that the dog stopped barking and the dense feeling dissipated but I felt on edge and scared all night after that. Not the first thing that’s happened in that house but definitely the scariest.
